 South Carolina State has already claimed the conference prize, and Delaware State arrives with a chance to complicate how the Bulldogs finish. SC State (9-2, 4-0 MEAC) locked up a third straight MEAC championship and a Celebration Bowl berth with a 38-24 win over North Carolina Central. The Bulldogs sit first in the conference table and have taken 14 consecutive conference games. Delaware State (6-5, 2-2 MEAC) sits fourth after a 30-24 loss to Howard, a game in which the Hornets held a 14-point lead before Howard came back.
 The quarterback numbers frame the contrast. Keely Watson has thrown for 1965 yards and 18 touchdowns with only 3 interceptions for SC State, and Mason Pickett-Hicks has added 785 rushing yards and 7 scores on the ground. Delaware State’s Ui Ale has passed for 1170 yards, 4 touchdowns and 5 interceptions, while Marqui Adams has 469 passing yards and 5 touchdown throws. Jaylin Terzado, with 472 receiving yards and 3 touchdowns, gives either passer a proven target.
 Delaware State at South Carolina State Game Information
 Game Date: November 21, 2026
 Game Time: 01:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: ESPN+ 
 Location: Oliver C. Dawson Stadium, Orangeburg, SC
 Live Stream: Fubo (free trial) 
 Game Preview
 The conference title is settled, but the Bulldogs still have something to play for in their home finale. A win would let them finish MEAC play undefeated, and they would carry that into the bowl game in Atlanta. Delaware State is looking to close its season with a road win over the league champion after the setback against Howard. The programs have met in a regular-season finale before, and SC State won that one 28-17. The Hornets have 6-5 on the line against the team at the top of the table.

 What to Watch For
 The pass rush may decide how comfortable either quarterback is. SC State’s Ka Von Chisolm has 9.5 sacks, and Delaware State’s Carl Nesmith has 9.0. Whichever can disrupt the pocket will shape the game, particularly for Ale, who has thrown 5 interceptions this season. Wayne Favors III has 3 interceptions for the Hornets, and Jabin Ford has 2 for SC State, so turnovers could swing the game either way.
 On the ground, Josh Shaw has scored 13 rushing touchdowns on 349 yards for SC State, a high rate of scoring from short range. Ricorian Brown adds 405 rushing yards and 4 scores. Delaware State’s Jayden Sauray has 324 rushing yards and 3 touchdowns, and Jayden Jenkins has 4 rushing touchdowns on 219 yards.
 Through the air, SC State’s Malaqhi Jones (592 receiving yards, 3 touchdowns) and DJ Maultsby (33 catches for 545 yards) give Watson multiple options. Delaware State’s Nathan Stewart (18 catches, 280 yards, 2 touchdowns) and Terrence Rone (24 catches, 278 yards) will look to keep pace.
